use default

is_prime(value: int) -> bool =>
    value > 1 /\ ((2..value)
        |> take_while(divisor => divisor * divisor <= value)
        |> all(divisor => value % divisor != 0))

let prime_sum = (0::41) |> map(is_prime) |> collect()

extend(chosen: LIST[int], taken: LIST[bool],
       size: int) -> Pipe[List[int]]
is
    if chosen.count == size then
        yield chosen |> collect()
    else
        let final = chosen.count == size - 1

        for candidate in 2::size do
            if (!final \/ candidate == size) /\ !taken[candidate] /\
                prime_sum[chosen[chosen.count - 1] + candidate] then
                taken[candidate] = true

                chosen.add(candidate)

                yield in extend(chosen, taken, size)

                chosen.remove_at(chosen.count - 1)

                taken[candidate] = false
            fi
        od
    fi
si

arrangements(size: int) -> Pipe[List[int]] =>
    extend([1] |> collect_list(),
           (0::size) |> map(_ => false) |> collect_list(),
           size)

let totals = LIST[int]()

for size in 2::20 do
    let shown mut = false
    let total mut = 0

    for arrangement in arrangements(size) do
        if !shown then
            write_line(arrangement |> map(value => "{value,3}") |> join(""))

            shown = true
        fi

        total = total + 1
    od

    totals.add(total)
od

write_line()
write_line("arrangements for each size:")
write_line("  {totals |> join(" ")}")
